verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented bulk-load command, COPY INTO, that loads files from a stage. Snowpipe is documented as the automated alternative to running COPY statements manually. A hands-on community report confirms COPY loads JSON Lines files and skips files it has already loaded, and the docs include a guide on loading semi-structured data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of CSV and Parquet format support, explicit documentation that stages point to cloud object storage (S3/GCS/Azure), and a full COPY INTO syntax or format-options reference.
